chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from more than one person, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to him: A man has a wife with him, then he marries another woman; is it permissible for him to give preference to her?
He said: “Yes. If she is a virgin, then seven days; and if she is previously married, then three days.”

key_terms.سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ: the allotted period of preference for a virgin bride
key_terms.فَثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ: the allotted period of preference for a previously married bride
key_terms.يُفَضِّلَهَا: to give her preference over another wife
key_terms.ٱلرَّجُلُ: the man in the legal case being asked about
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةُ: the wife already in his marriage

ai.seo_question: Can a man give a newly married wife preference over an existing wife in the beginning of marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who marries an additional wife while already having a wife. It states that he may give the new wife an initial period of preference: seven days if she is a virgin, and three days if she is previously married.
